subject: 青铜峡一百零八塔 · 最上三行七塔局部
author: Smwy09
source_note: 实拍核对最上三行1、3、3排列，图版仅绘七座塔及台地。始建按青铜峡市政府西夏说说明，保留1988年国保名录元代登记差异；现存修缮外装不能一概视为西夏原砖。
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct ONLY the background and black ink in this seven-stupa line drawing. Preserve its EXACT arrangement: one larger top tower, three middle towers, three lower towers, their silhouettes and three retaining terraces. It is a detail of the top three rows of the 108 Stupas in Qingtongxia.
Return an OPAQUE BLACK-ON-WHITE PNG, NOT a cutout. Fill the ENTIRE canvas, every pixel including all interiors and exteriors, with SOLID PURE WHITE #FFFFFF at 100% opacity, then retain only the thin solid BLACK contour strokes. The current transparent grey glow is a defect: remove ALL transparency, ALL grey glow, ALL tonal fills, ALL gradients and ALL shading. All unmarked pixels must be uniform opaque white. Fine black outlines only. Do not draw a black backdrop or checkerboard. White background is essential; a separate local script will prepare a transparent copy later, this original MUST be white and opaque.
Landscape 1536x1024. Preserve enough margin so no stroke touches any outer edge. No text, scenery, reconstructed temple or extra towers.

checks: 可数七座塔，三行1、3、3排列，顶塔较大。
仅七塔与承托台地，不绘顶后殿宇、全塔群、文字与现代设施。
白底原件通过纯白边缘及中性线条检查，透明交付保留可见轮廓。
review.limitations: 艺术转译，不是实测图；用户已确认当前交付图版通过，不能据此声称文保级复原。

generation_history.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing; use only its delicate sparse organic thin lines and open unmarked white areas, NOT its shape. Image 2 is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: One Hundred and Eight Stupas at Qingtongxia, Ningxia.
Draw an explicitly LIMITED DETAIL of the TOP THREE ROWS ONLY, exactly SEVEN actual brick stupas from photo 2: first/top row ONE larger central stupa; second/middle row THREE smaller stupas; third/bottom row THREE smaller stupas. Preserve these three rows and the actual silhouettes of the corresponding top seven towers; DO NOT draw all 108 and DO NOT add towers. Three low stepped retaining terraces support the rows; no roofs or temple behind, no hills, sky, trees, tourists, fences or modern stair handrails. Towers have squat masonry plinths, rounded tapering bell/body forms and short neck/ring/umbrella/jewel finials, as in those top seven photographed towers. Topmost tower is visibly larger. Do not substitute Tibetan white-painted modern chortens or tall Chinese pavilion pagodas.
Near straight-on elevation, gentle perspective only, all seven towers separated and countable, centered on landscape 1536x1024 canvas with 8% breathing room. The entire SELECTED SEVEN-TOWER detail must fit uncut. Only a few structural terrace contours.
Refined sparse BLACK INK outlines and a few finer internal lines on perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF. No solid dark door fills, no wash, tonal shading, grey, crosshatching, paper texture, pencil grain, gradients, color, shadows, halo or checkerboard. Most masonry surfaces remain blank pure white; omit dense brick texture. No labels, lettering, watermark, border or frame. White canvas will be removed later by a local script.
generation_history.reason: RGBA首稿带透明灰色光晕，既非合格白底原件也非合格原生透明图，不用于交付。
